page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7.32xlarge is a compute-optimized server instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance type does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. It offers a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps to support high-throughput networking requirements. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and high compute-to-memory ratio make it suitable for workloads requiring dense CPU resources without the overhead of excess memory.

The ecs.c7.32xlarge is designed for compute-heavy workloads. Appropriate use cases include high-performance web serving, batch processing, distributed analytics, and compute-intensive applications that benefit from high-frequency Intel Xeon processors and a 64 Gbps network interface.
